annotations: The owner, 2026-09-30 (OWNER-DECISIONS 130): "Yes, open them" - Capitol Circle Drive and the Capitol Driveways. Two groups, both inside the AOC polygon. (1) The service drives tagged access=private, bicycle=yes (Capitol Circle Drive, Capitol Circle Northeast, Capitol Driveway Northeast/Southeast, the New Jersey Avenue SE stub and unnamed links): bicycle=yes alone does not open them, because upstream's transform sets the way's private (destination-only) flag from access and motor_vehicle and never from bicycle (lua/vendor/graph_upstream.lua, kv["private"] = private[kv["access"]] or private[kv["motor_vehicle"]] ...; pinned in tests/lua/test_graph_entry.lua), so each row also writes access=permissive, and motor_vehicle=no, which all but way 905189929 already carry. (2) The linear highway=pedestrian drives with no bicycle tag: bicycle=yes. Thirteen pedestrian areas (area=yes) inside the polygon are left out: upstream does not route areas. Every other restriction on the grounds (the private residential streets, the private passages, the service accesses without bicycle=yes) is untouched.
